# Reveal the Dock Layouts card in 13.2.0: no sync flips it after the deploy

## Context

Found during the v13.2 release rehearsal (#14800, cut list item 8). All four Portal example registries open with the "Dock Layouts" card (id 28, `examples/dashboard/choreography`) at index 0 with `hidden: true`. #17436 release-gated it that way on 2026-08-20.

## The Problem

#17436's plan was to flip the card when the Pages release contains the app. At that time an hourly Data Sync deletion-synced `apps/portal/resources/data/**` into `neomjs/pages`, so a flip on `dev` reached neomjs.com within the hour. Gating the card protected the live 13.1 site from a link to an app it did not serve.

That sync is gone:
- `neomjs/pages`' last `chore(data): Sync data and content from neo repo` commit is `1847ca65b` (2026-08-31);
- no workflow in `neomjs/neo` references `neomjs/pages` any more.

The registries now reach neomjs.com only inside the release package, which a pages deploy installs. If 13.2.0 ships the card hidden, the 13.2 site hides the app the release notes lead with (*🧩 Dock Layouts*). It stays hidden until 13.3.

Measured 2026-10-06 on the live 13.1 site: `examples/dashboard/choreography/index.html` returns 200, and its `dist/development`, `dist/esm` and `dist/production` builds return 404. The 13.2.0 rehearsal package carries the app's source, and the rehearsed pages build produced all three `dist` builds.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Design authority:** #17436's ledger row "DockDemo card … hidden on v13.1 … `hidden: true` … four runtime URLs return 404 before v13.2", and its Fix: "Flip visibility only when the corresponding Pages release contains the app". `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins the gated state with the message "DockDemo stays top-ranked for the v13.2 reveal".
- `Portal.model.Example#hidden` is Boolean; `Portal.view.examples.List#isHiddenItem()` keeps hidden cards out of the DOM.
- The four registries: `apps/portal/resources/data/examples_{devmode,dist_dev,dist_esm,dist_prod}.json`.

## The Fix

Drop `"hidden": true` from the Dock Layouts row in all four registries. Turn the spec arm around: Dock Layouts is the first card shown and DevIndex stays visible. The PR merges right before the cut, beside neo #19423. That keeps the reveal inside the 13.2.0 package, so no other path that reads `dev` can show the card earlier.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] In all four registries, Dock Layouts is index 0 and has no `hidden` flag. The other rows are unchanged.
- [ ] The spec arm asserts Dock Layouts is the first visible card and DevIndex stays visible, and it fails on today's `dev`.
- [ ] *(post-merge, after the 13.2 deploy)* The four runtime URLs return 200 on neomjs.com and the Portal's examples gallery shows the card first. This becomes part of the deployed read owned on #17416.

## Out of Scope

- Any other hidden row in the registries.
- The card's image or description.
